manifest: Stage 1 retrain under plan v8.1 (addendum sections 3.1 and 8): frozen BEFORE any corrected-regime result is opened
code: HEAD at the launch commit (recorded in the run log); Stage 0 modules 4ad6f91/63afc53/c90e181, wiring 550e7d8

gauge.convention: frozen-pristine spectral gauge, addendum 3.1: mu_g = rank-normalised occupied trace on the class table's pristine reference (1x1x1 tiling of its first stoichiometric frame); H_fix = Htilde - mu_g I on every runtime graph; the class-table edges re-aligned under it; gap floor per defect_gauge.DEFAULT_GAP_FLOOR

objective.residual_paths: exactly one per charged observation: r_i^Delta when the frame is a paired member (delta_energy label present), r_i otherwise; the current dataset carries no pair_id groups, so every charged frame is unpaired
objective.stratum_weights_rule: W_g = 1.0 for every represented stratum (equal weight, independent of frame count); within-stratum w_i = the frame's loader `weight` column (1.0 on every frame of this dataset), normalised to one. NOT the Stage B OOD w_E (energy_weight), which no term reads under this objective
objective.pair_rule: WithinStratumPairSampler: 2 pairs appended to every batch of 8 (12 graphs per batch); stratum drawn with probability W_g / sum W; members with probability w_i, with replacement. The pair graphs enter ONLY the shape term: the collater zeroes their `weight` and rescales the base graphs' columns so every other term equals its value on the 8 base graphs alone (PairBatchCollater; pinned by test). The realised force shares are therefore the recipe's
objective.energy_shape_weight_rationale: the saved-seed recalibration gives within-stratum RMS 0.26-0.32 eV at 79 atoms and 0.04-0.06 eV at 159 atoms, so a pair term of about 0.09 eV^2 per 79-atom pair; at weight 0.5 it is of the same order as the force term (100 x mean squared force error, about 0.04 at convergence). Chosen before any corrected-regime result; a different weight is a different regime
objective.neutral_null_rule: retired; DEFECT_NULL_REFERENCE and DEFECT_CHARGED_ENERGY_SHARE unset; every charged energy of both sizes enters through its stratum
objective.validation: plain loader, no pair slots: the shape term is not scored on validation batches; the held-out shape diagnostic is stage1_recalibrate.py's centred within-stratum RMS

held_out_joint_tolerance.population: dataset_pbe/valid.xyz, charged frames, per size stratum
held_out_joint_tolerance.energy_shape_rms_eV: train-centred (training c_g*) held-out RMS <= 0.50 eV at 79 atoms; reported at 159 (one frame)
held_out_joint_tolerance.force_rmse_meV_A: charged 79 <= 45, charged 159 <= 35 (the retrained arm (a) cohort's mean plus its seed sd under the old objective)
held_out_joint_tolerance.size_conflict: the sign of the mean centred held-out residual must not differ between the two size strata by more than 0.3 eV; a larger conflict routes to objective-identifiability review, never to dropping a population

decision_table_scalar_range_ablation.status: RETROSPECTIVE for arm (a): its old-objective numbers were inspected before this table was written; pre-registered for the corrected-regime retrains of every arm
decision_table_scalar_range_ablation.rule: an arm is preferred only where it improves at least one metric by more than max(tau_phys, tau_noise) and regresses none beyond its equivalence margin; indistinguishable arms resolve to the simpler one; hard gates (identities, FD) are constraints, not scores
decision_table_scalar_range_ablation.existing_arms_policy: arms (b) and (c) are retrained under the corrected regime only if the recalibrated selection readouts of the old regime change the ordering; the old-regime readouts (arm (a) retrained; arms (b), (c) forward-only) retained arm (a)
